name: HireVue
tagline: AI hiring platform for assessments and video interviews.
description: HireVue is an enterprise hiring platform that uses AI to screen and validate candidate skills through video interviews, game-based and technical assessments, and an AI Interviewer. It adds candidate matching, scheduling, and workflow automation, with deep ATS integrations. Widely used for high-volume and structured hiring.
insight: Dropped facial-analysis scoring from its video interviews in 2021 after bias complaints, moving to language- and skills-based assessment.
edge: One of the most established, ATS-integrated video-assessment platforms, and FedRAMP-authorized for public-sector hiring.
pros: Scales structured screening to high volume
cons: Past bias/transparency criticism over AI scoring

references.title: HireVue drops facial monitoring amid A.I. algorithm audit
